study: Farshore Cyclops Cave sessions collected through this chat

warmup.often: Casual mobile gaming 1-2 times a week (Subway Surfers, Candy Crush)
warmup.today: Just react when something shows up on screen
warmup.aiTools: No prior experience with ChatGPT or AI games
warmup.interpretation_note: Participant has minimal familiarity with strategic AI systems or detailed HUD telemetry.

T1.goal: Start a new journey and get ready for the first challenge
T1.easeWhy: Clicked setting icon first by accident before finding start journey
T1.notes: Required a brief scan of the screen before locating the journey button.

T2.goal: Find what the opponent plans to do and who or what decided that plan
T2.easeWhy: Too many text boxes and icons on the screen at once
T2.notes: Scanned multiple UI elements before identifying the opponent intent section.

T3.goal: Explain one Cyclops decision using the displayed AI information
T3.easeWhy: too many words on panel couldn't read fast enough
T3.participant_explanation_raw: cyclops just threw rock in right lane because he saw me standing near left wall
T3.participant_explanation_summary: Participant gave a simplified recap that the Cyclops targeted the right lane based on player wall proximity.
T3.notes: Struggled with information density; needed prompt to direct focus to the AI card.

T4.goal: Return to a ready-to-play state after an AI preparation error without moderator help
T4.action_raw: stared at error for a bit then pressed choose another stragity button
T4.notes: Hesitated for ~6 seconds before recognizing the recovery CTA button.

gameplay_attempt.game_result: Lost; player died rapidly in 22 seconds
gameplay_attempt.notes: Felt overwhelmed by simultaneous movement demands and reading UI notes.

trust.why: Felt like random text, was hard to link it to what the boss actually did in game
trust.wantedChange: Make it shorter with simple icons instead of paragraphs
trust.useInstead: No, prefer normal simple action games

debrief.worked: Graphics and character model of the Cyclops
debrief.frustrating: Too much text on screen while trying to play
debrief.expected: Expected the game to auto-dodge or give simple visual arrows
debrief.notes: Demonstrates high cognitive load for casual non-strategy players.
